column1: # Columns: kind, app, label, note (kind is credential|app|shell)
# The app column is the single owner of what `checklist --open-apps` opens AND
# of which heading an app row prints under: a row with candidate paths is
# opened and listed as opened, a "-" row is listed as needing in-app setup.
# The two lists cannot drift apart because they are one column.
# Candidates are separated by "|" and the first one that exists is opened, so a
# tool shipping under more than one name stays a single row.
# An app may appear twice when it needs both: one row that opens it and one "-"
# row for the step that follows. Notes expand $DOTFILES_ROOT, nothing else.
# Row order within a kind is display order.
